INSERT INTO source (openalex_id, issn_l, issns, title, publisher, host, country, origin, tier, tier_set_by) VALUES (#{o.openalexId}, #{o.issnL}, COALESCE(#{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), COALESCE(#{o.title}, (COALESCE(#{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]))[1], #{o.issnL}, #{o.openalexId}), #{o.publisher}, #{o.host}, #{o.country}, COALESCE(#{o.origin}, 'DISCOVERED'), 'CANDIDATE', 'SEED') RETURNING id

mapper.select: INSERT INTO source (openalex_id, issn_l, issns, title, publisher, host, is_oa, in_doaj, tier, origin, adapter_config, active, subfields, primary_subfield, journal_type, taxgroups, taxgroup_shares, codes, oa_model, country, name_density, act_rate, works_per_year, last_harvested, tier_set_by) VALUES (#{o.openalexId}, #{o.issnL}, COALESCE(#{o.issns, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{o.title}, #{o.publisher}, #{o.host}, #{o.isOa}, #{o.inDoaj}, COALESCE(#{o.tier}, 'CANDIDATE'), #{o.origin}, COALESCE(#{o.adapterConfig, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{o.active}, true), COALESCE(#{o.subfields, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{o.primarySubfield}, #{o.journalType}, COALESCE(#{o.taxgroups, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), COALESCE(#{o.taxgroupShares, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{o.codes, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{o.oaModel}, #{o.country}, #{o.nameDensity}, #{o.actRate}, #{o.worksPerYear}, #{o.lastHarvested}, COALESCE(#{o.tierSetBy}, 'SEED')) ON CONFLICT (openalex_id) DO UPDATE SET issn_l = EXCLUDED.issn_l, issns = EXCLUDED.issns, title = EXCLUDED.title, publisher = EXCLUDED.publisher, host = EXCLUDED.host, is_oa = EXCLUDED.is_oa, in_doaj = EXCLUDED.in_doaj, subfields = EXCLUDED.subfields, primary_subfield = EXCLUDED.primary_subfield, oa_model = EXCLUDED.oa_model, country = EXCLUDED.country, works_per_year = EXCLUDED.works_per_year, modified = now() RETURNING id
SELECT tier, count(*) AS n FROM source GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier

SELECT s.id AS source_id, s.tier, count(*) AS works, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.has_acts) AS acts, COALESCE(sum(n.names), 0) AS names FROM source s JOIN work w ON w.source_id = s.id AND w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year >= #{fromYear} LEFT JOIN (SELECT work_id, count(*) AS names FROM work_name WHERE NOT only_reference GROUP BY work_id) n ON n.work_id = w.id GROUP BY s.id, s.tier HAVING count(*) >= #{minWorks}

SELECT w.source_id AS source_id, wn.codewn.taxgroup AS grp, count(*) AS n FROM work w JOIN work_name wn ON wn.work_id = w.id AND wn.main_subject AND NOT wn.only_reference WHERE w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year >= #{fromYear} AND w.source_id IS NOT NULL AND wn.codewn.taxgroup IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.source_id, grp
